messages.content: Three managers want the same window desk. Give me the ruling in two lines, grave and a little ridiculous.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=banter|construct=comedy|persona=vader|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
One desk, three claims. The ruling has to be arbitrary and final or it becomes a fourth meeting.
</think>

"The desk goes to whoever is already sitting in it tomorrow at 9."
Nobody laughed until they realized he was also not going to hold the meeting.
